SELECT A.MOVE_NO, /* 재고이동요청번호 */ A.MOVE_SEQ, /* 재고이동요청순번 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR, /* 출발물류센터 */ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR_TEXT, /* 출발물류센터 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO, /* 도착물류센터 */ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO_TEXT, /* 출발물류센터 */ A.STATUS, /* 진행상태 */ CASE WHEN A.STATUS = '1' THEN '이동요청' WHEN A.STATUS = '2' THEN '이동출고' WHEN A.STATUS = '3' THEN '이동입고' WHEN A.STATUS = '9' THEN '요청취소' END STATUS_TEXT, /* 진행상태 */ CASE WHEN A.STATUS = '1' THEN '0' WHEN A.STATUS = '2' THEN '1' WHEN A.STATUS = '3' THEN '1' WHEN A.STATUS = '9' THEN '0' END STATUS_IMG, /* RD 호출 상태 */ A.STDCATLG_ID, /* 품목코드 */ B.DESCRIPTION, /* 품목명 */ B.SPECIFICATION, /* 규격 */ B.UNIT_MEASURE, A.REQ_QTY, /* 이동요청수량 */ A.REQ_DATE, /* 이동요청일자 */ A.REQ_TIME, /* 이동요청시간 */ A.REQ_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NM, /* 이동요청자 */ A.INV_QTY, /* 이동출고수량 */ A.INV_DATE, /* 이동출고일자 */ DECODE(A.INV_TIME, NULL, '', (SUBSTR(A.INV_TIME,0,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.INV_TIME,3,2))) INV_TIME, /* 이동출고시간 */ (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.INV_USER_ID) AS INV_USER_NM, /* 이동출고자자 */ A.GR_QTY, /* 이동입고수량 */ A.GR_DATE, /* 이동입고일자 */ DECODE(A.GR_TIME, NULL, '', (SUBSTR(A.GR_TIME,0,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.GR_TIME,3,2))) GR_TIME, /* 이동입고시간 */ (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.GR_USER_ID) AS GR_USER_NM, /* 이동입고자 */ A.ADD_DATE, DECODE(A.ADD_TIME, NULL, '', (SUBSTR(A.ADD_TIME,0,2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.ADD_TIME,3,2))) ADD_TIME, /*이동요청등록시간 */ B.CONTRACT_NO, B.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.MOVE_REMARK /* 비고 */ FROM BNTWMSMOVE A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE 1=1 AND (SELECT DISTINCT ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM WMSSTCK WHERE STDCATLG_ID = A.STDCATLG_ID AND WAREHOUSE_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR) = B.BUYER AND A.STDCATLG_ID = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = #{st_warehouse_code} /* 조회조건(출발물류센터) */
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO = #{st_warehouse_code} /* 조회조건(도착물류센터) */
AND A.MOVE_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_move_no} || '%' /* 조회조건(출고번호) */
AND A.REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} /* 조회조건(요청일자) */
AND A.REQ_USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{st_req_user_id} || '%' /* 조회조건(출발물류센터) */
AND A.STDCATLG_ID LIKE '%' || #{st_stdcatlg_id} || '%' /* 조회조건(품목코드) */
AND B.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%' /* 조회조건(품목명) */
AND A.STATUS = #{st_status} /* 조회조건(진행상태) */
ORDER BY A.MOVE_NO, A.MOVE_SEQ, A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR, A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO, A.STDCATLG_ID
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
